annotationRationale: Counting prime factors determines the trailing zeros. Divisibility modulo 9 and 11 restricts the digit sum and alternating digit sum, and elementary elimination recovers the digits.

review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, independently worded adaptation of official solution 14 on page 6: count trailing zeros, apply divisibility by 9 and 11, then combine digit constraints. The candidate explicitly supplies the official solution's abbreviated case elimination.
review.annotationCheck: The assessed factorial and congruence skills match the decisive reasoning; elimination is appropriately supporting knowledge. No material omission.
